records.title: Keep DOM-only fixtures explicit after script defaults change
records.summary: The old default executes the controlled inline script. The target default leaves it inert. Explicit DOM setup yields the intended fixture state without evaluation.
conditions: A DOM test relies on script markup inside a Happy DOM window to set up fixture state.
actions: Construct fixture state through the DOM API. If executing application scripts is the purpose of the test, exercise them in the project’s browser-managed test environment.
verification: Run the owning tests and confirm that only the intended harness evaluates scripts.
